quests.title: Custom Gift Envelope No. 4

dialogue.t: Happy Lantern Rite, {NICKNAME}. I heard about how you helped Dehya with the gift envelope. It was beautiful, thank you.

dialogue.sit: Everything is settled back at the village, I'm guessing?

dialogue.t: Yes, it's all thanks to Dehya and the others. I can rest a little easier knowing the village is still protected while I'm gone.

dialogue.sit: Take this time to get some good rest.

dialogue.t: I will. Dehya wants to visit Qiaoying Village in a few days.
She said the scenery is beautiful, and the village is known for their tea. It's a perfect gift for the people back home.
I was planning to follow the tradition here and make a few gift envelopes for them.
But, Dehya packed our schedule to the brim, and with all the running around, I'm not sure I'll have the time...
Dehya told me you're good at making gift envelopes. Could you show me how to make one?

dialogue.sit: Of course, just leave it to me.

dialogue.t: Dehya told me you're good at making gift envelopes. Could you show me how to make one?

dialogue.sit: Of course, just leave it to me.

dialogue.t: So, that's how it's done... This gift envelope is wonderful, {NICKNAME}, thank you.
Now, I just need to make a few more to give alongside the souvenirs I bought. I'm sure the people back home will love them.
But, this one... I'm keeping just for me.

quests.description: Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope…
